reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Ignoring all status updates and high churn mutations: Argo CD manifest now contains a default configuration for `resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates`…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Watched resources' .status changes and common mutated resources will be ignored by default, reducing load on Argo CD; this changes behavior from v2.14 where these were processed.
consequence.remediation: If v2 behavior is required, override or remove the resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates configuration in the argocd-cm ConfigMap.

proposed.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds a default configuration for resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates in the argocd-cm ConfigMap that excludes common mutated resources and always ignores .status changes; the v2 behavior can be preserved by overriding or removing this configuration.
